title: The Wrapped Lens
narration: Inside the dry boathouse, the group finds the beacon lens wrapped in sailcloth beside a maintenance note.

dialogue.text: The lens is safe. This note says the wind gate must be aligned before we fit it.

choices.label: Inspect the lens before carrying it

continuityFacts: The lens was found safely at the old boathouse.
A maintenance note connected the repair to the wind gate.
